page.overview:
What is Ahghairon's Tower?

Ahghairon's Tower was the home and eventually the final resting place of Ahghairon, the first Open Lord of Waterdeep.

Ahghairon's Tower was located in a courtyard at the intersection of the Street of Silks and Waterdeep Way in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep.

Ahghairon's Tower was haunted by several grim sights. One was the skeleton of Melkar of Mirabar, a wizard who had attempted to breach the tower. His skeleton stood inside the magical fields facing the north side of the tower, with its arms stretched wide.

Local children made it a game to rearrange the bones inside the fields with a long stick, as the bones would always eventually drift back into position. The practice was eventually banned by the Open Lord, Piergeiron Paladinson.
